text:
brightbank_csm: Hey team — we pushed the app yesterday and our support volume jumped. Customers say the assistant is now much terser and stops giving clarifying questions. Examples attached. Can someone look? :frowning:

amanda: Thanks for flagging. Do you have a pair of before/after outputs we can paste here? Which model version did you move to?

brightbank_csm: We were on rwd-model:v9 (hosted) -> rolled to rwd-model:v10. Small config change only. Two examples below.

brightbank_csm: EXAMPLE 1 (user prompt)

```
User: "How do I integrate payroll for contractors across two countries?"
```

BEFORE (v9):
```
Assistant: You can integrate payroll by using a payroll provider that supports multi-country payouts. Steps:
1) Collect contractor tax/residency info per country.
2) Choose provider with local payout rails.
3) Configure currency conversion and fees.
4) Add contract templates and run a pilot with a subset.
Would you like a checklist for the pilot or provider recommendations?"
```

AFTER (v10):
```
Assistant: Use a payroll provider that supports both countries. Configure payouts and taxes.
```

brightbank_csm: Notice v10 removes the step breakdown and doesn't ask follow-ups. Customers say it's less helpful and they open tickets more frequently.

amanda: Oof. That behavior change could explain the support spike. @liam / @sanjay can you triage whether this is model behavior vs prompt handling in our middleware?

liam: I pulled a few traces. Incoming prompts are unchanged. We see model_variant header "v10-lite" for some requests (fallback path). For others it's "v10-standard". Example request log:
```
{"req_id": "rk_abc123", "model": "rwd-model:v10", "variant": "v10-lite", "route": "/generate", "latency_ms": 120}
```

liam: I repro locally with the hosted endpoint using the same prompt. v9 returns expanded bullets + follow-up. v10-lite returns a terse paragraph. v10-standard is closer to v9 but still trims follow-ups.

sanjay: Hypothesis: decoding params or system assistant prompt got tightened during v10 rollout. Also v10-lite might be a quantized variant with slightly different tokenization leading to shorter completions. Will run comparison sweep of system prompt + temp/top_p.

jordan: Repro steps for anyone trying: 
1) curl call with example below (use the exact user prompt) 
2) compare token counts and trailing punctuation/follow-up ques.

cURL repro:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-model:v10","input":"How do I integrate payroll for contractors across two countries?","max_tokens":250}'
```

amanda: Any quick mitigation we can do for BrightBank? They want either rollback to v9 for them or a prompt shim to restore clarifying questions.

liam: We can route their org to pinned model v9 in dedicated routing in ~15m. I'll open an emergency pin. @support-bot can we do a quick config change for org:brightbank?

support-bot: Scheduled change queued — routing rule: org=brightbank -> rwd-model:v9 (exec at 2026-03-17T16:18:00Z). :white_check_mark:

amanda: Great, thanks. Also capturing this as an escalation so eng-ml can investigate v10 decoding/profile drift.

sanjay: I'll run a batch diff across a representative prompt set (long-form explainers, troubleshooting flows) comparing v9 / v10-standard / v10-lite. Will post summary and top 10 regressions.

liam: Early note: token entropy in v10-standard seems slightly lower around step boundaries. Might be a beam or penalize setting. Logging config and rollout notes now.

ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy_9876 completed for release/v10 at 2026-03-17T15:05:12Z. Canary: 10% traffic. Change: system_prompt shortened by ~18 tokens (see release notes). :information_source:

amanda: Ah — system_prompt change could explain missing follow-ups. Does anyone have the diff for that prompt?

sanjay: Pulling the system prompt versions now. If the trimmed system prompt removed explicit "ask clarifying questions when user intent is ambiguous" line, that's likely the cause.

brightbank_csm: Appreciate the fast pin to v9. Customers already calmer. Please keep me posted on root cause so we can plan messaging.

liam: Will post next steps. For triage owners: @sanjay lead ML diff, @liam trace routing/variant selection. I'll also add a small prompt shim we can inject server-side as temporary fix for orgs that report this.

amanda: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with BrightBank and close loop once we have a mitigation timeline. :thumbsup:
